2026-11-26.title: Taylor Tomlinson: Have It All
2026-11-26.overview: Can Taylor Tomlinson have it all? From dating woes to dream jobs to inventive dirty talk, she shares life's ups and downs in this stand-up comedy special.

2026-11-26.title: Chris Rock: Selective Outrage
2026-11-26.overview: Chris Rock delivers an electric stand-up set on non-racist yoga pants, spoiling his kids, the Kardashians and his thoughts on the Will Smith fiasco.

2026-11-26.title: Kate Berlant: Cinnamon in the Wind
2026-11-26.overview: In her first live solo standup special, filmed in 2019, Kate Berlant performs an absurdist set, in an intimate space, shared not only with the audience but the mirror reflection of herself. Kate's special distorts audience's expectations to her comedy, while also exploring her clairvoyant connection to the crowd and her inability to stop performing.

2026-11-26.title: Kurt Braunohler: Perfectly Stupid
2026-11-26.overview: An hour of standup comedy by comedian Kurt Braunohler. Directed by Jonah Ray Rodrigues and released by 800 Pound Gorilla. Braunohler explores family, absurdity, and his role in both.

2026-11-26.title: Eddie Izzard: Unrepeatable
2026-11-26.overview: Recorded one night at the Albert Theatre in March 1994, when Eddie Izzard was playing a limited seven week sold-out run of her celebrated stand-up show.

2026-11-26.title: Marlon Wayans: Good Grief
2026-11-26.overview: Taped at the iconic Apollo Theater, Wayans comedically explores grief after losing his parents. He reflects on his father's lessons, joining the "Dead Mama Club," changing aging parents' diapers, and who's the funniest Wayans.

2026-11-26.title: Heckler
2026-11-26.overview: HECKLER is a comedic feature documentary exploring the increasingly critical world we live in. After starring in a film that was critically bashed, Jamie Kennedy takes on hecklers and critics and ask some interesting questions of people such as George Lucas, Bill Maher, Mike Ditka, Rob Zombie, Howie Mandel and many more. This fast moving, hilarious documentary pulls no punches as you see an uncensored look at just how nasty and mean the fight is between those in the spotlight and those in the dark.

2026-11-26.title: The Apollo
2026-11-26.overview: The history of New York City's Apollo Theater in Harlem is given the full treatment.

2026-11-26.title: Tom Segura: Sledgehammer
2026-11-26.overview: From his dad's unusual deathbed confession to watching his mom get high, Tom Segura tells blisteringly candid stories about marriage, mortality and more.

2026-11-26.title: Tim Dillon: A Real Hero
2026-11-26.overview: Tim Dillon rants about fast food, living in Texas, Disney adults and the reason no one should be called a hero.

2026-11-26.title: Sean Lock: Purple Van Man
2026-11-26.overview: Purple Van Man, is 8 out of 10 Cats star Sean Lock's fantastic new DVD, recorded in front of a sold out audience at London's Hammersmith Apollo. We all know what white van man thinks about the world we live in but it's time to hear a different voice, the purple van man's voice. Filled with gags, opinions, deft observations and some silly voices, this is Sean Lock doing what he does best, spouting inspired jibber jabber as he crosses the country in his purple van. He will make you laugh like a drunken horse.

2026-11-26.title: Deon Cole: Charleen's Boy
2026-11-26.overview: In an electric stand-up special, Deon Cole ponders romance, racist hotel showers, post-coital bedtime prayers and why he loves women of a certain age.

2026-11-26.title: Steve-O's Bucket List
2026-11-26.overview: Steve-O new unrated special, filmed in front of a sold-out crowd, sees him in top form as he brings his comedy tour straight into your living room with his hilarious stand-up and stunts.

2026-11-26.title: Joe Lycett: That's the Way, A-Ha, A-Ha, Joe Lycett - Live
2026-11-26.overview: Live stand-up performance by English comedian Joe Lycett, recorded in May 2016 at The Duchess Theatre in London. The show includes the Birmingham comic's mischievous views on sexuality, politics and celebrity culture.

2026-11-26.title: Nigel Ng: The HAIYAA Special
2026-11-26.overview: Uncle Roger and his nephew Nigel Ng present The HAIYAA Special, filmed on their sold out world tour. In this two-part special, Uncle Roger roasts the crowd, while Nigel delivers side-splitting commentary on life and culture. Allergic to MSG and inappropriate jokes? You've been warned.

2026-11-26.title: Lewis Black: Black on Broadway
2026-11-26.overview: Lewis Black goes on tirade after tirade about stupidity in America. He covers everything from corporate greed and Martha Stewart to WMDs and homeland security.

2026-11-26.title: Lee Evans: Roadrunner
2026-11-26.overview: Wired And Wonderful was huge... XL was big... Big was even bigger... now the legendary Lee Evans embarks on his most ambitious tour to date. Roadrunner is Lee's amazing new show with over 60 nights in the biggest arenas in the country. Lee will be playing to more fans than ever on this record- breaking tour of the UK and R.O.I in 2011 with the show filmed for DVD during his 5 nights at the 02.

2026-11-26.title: Michael McIntyre: Live & Laughing
2026-11-26.overview: Acclaimed stand-up comedian Michael McIntyre delivers a hilarious performance to a receptive crowd at London's Hammersmith Apollo.

2026-11-26.title: Death to 2021
2026-11-26.overview: This comedic retrospective mixes archival footage and scripted sketches as it revisits all the dread — and occasional delight — that 2021 had to offer.

2026-11-26.title: Shane Gillis: Beautiful Dogs
2026-11-26.overview: In a rowdy stand-up set, Shane Gillis riffs on his girlfriend's Navy SEAL ex, touring George Washington's house and being bullied by an Australian Goth.

2026-11-26.title: Greg Davies: The Back of My Mum's Head
2026-11-26.overview: Inspired by his mother's insistence that he's "not normal," comedian Greg Davies puts everyone under a comedic microscope during this live comedy performance.

2026-11-26.title: Jimmy Carr: The Best of Ultimate Gold Greatest Hits
2026-11-26.overview: Nothing is off limits as Jimmy Carr serves up the most outrageous jokes from his stand-up career in a special that's not for the faint of heart.

2026-11-26.title: Ricky Gervais Live 4: Science
2026-11-26.overview: Ricky Gervais Live IV Science or the way things worked before we invented God. The hilarious fourth live smash hit stand up show from Ricky Gervais, following his complete sell out tour - filmed live at London's Hammersmith HMV Apollo

2026-11-27.title: Joe Rogan: Strange Times
2026-11-27.overview: Outspoken as ever, comedian Joe Rogan takes on politics, pro wrestling, pot laws, cats, vegans and much more in a stand-up special shot in Boston.

2026-11-27.title: Bo Burnham: Inside
2026-11-27.overview: Stuck in COVID-19 lockdown, US comedian and musician Bo Burnham attempts to stay sane and happy by writing, shooting and performing a one-man comedy special.

2026-11-27.title: Taylor Tomlinson: Look at You
2026-11-27.overview: Breakups. Therapy. Bangs. Taylor's gone through some stuff since her quarter-life crisis, and she spins her mental health journey into insightful comedy.

2026-11-27.title: Ladykiller
2026-11-27.overview: In her latest comedy special, Jena Friedman probes America’s obsession with (dead) women, finding humor in marriage, motherhood, and murder.

2026-11-27.title: John Leguizamo's Latin History for Morons
2026-11-27.overview: In this one-man Broadway show, John Leguizamo finds humor and heartbreak as he traces 3,000 years of Latin history in an effort to help his bullied son.

2026-11-27.title: Caleb Hearon: Model Comedian
2026-11-27.overview: ​In his debut stand-up special, actor, comedian, writer, and podcaster Caleb Hearon takes us back to his roots in Kansas City...where it all started. Newly 30, Hearon deploys his generational Midwestern wisdom to solve most of the world's problems: politics, internet trolls, learning we're not that different from our parents, and more.

2026-11-27.title: Eddie Murphy: Delirious
2026-11-27.overview: Taped live and in concert at Constitution Hall in Washington, D.C. in August, 1983, Eddie Murphy: Delirious captures Eddie Murphy's wild and outrageous stand-up comedy act, which he performed in New York and eighteen other cities across the U.S. to standing-room-only audiences. Eddie's comedy was groundbreaking, completely new, razor sharp and definitely funny.Eddie Murphy pontificates in his own vulgarly hilarious fashion on everything from bizarre sexual fantasies to reliving the family barbecue, and is peppered with Eddie's one-of-a-kind wit. Laugh along as Eddie reminiscences of hot childhood days and the ice cream man intermixed with classic vocal parodies of top American entertainers.Experience Eddie Murphy at his best, live and red hot! Delirious! Uncensored and Uncut!

2026-11-27.title: Matt Rife: Only Fans
2026-11-27.overview: Comedian Matt Rife discusses his world of deceptive good looks, women and even a charismatic perspective of the world's more pressing topics.

2026-11-27.title: Bill Bailey: Dandelion Mind
2026-11-27.overview: Featuring Bill’s trademark musical interludes, observations and stories of the road, Dandelion Mind will be based loosely on the theme of doubt (or will it?), as we follow Bill from his real-life saga of being trapped by the ash cloud, to his barely contained rants about celebrity, TV, creationism and Michael Winner. He demonstrates new instruments, both ancient and modern, he sings an internet love song, a lament about punk heroes, Iranian hip-hop, and plays a mean folk-bouzouki. Thomas the Doubter gets a new look, and Darwin’s curious obsessions and the myth of intelligent design are all worked over in Bailey’s own surreal style. He revisits the music of his youth, with a brand-new French Disco re-working of Gary Numan’s hit, Cars, played in his own inimitable way, and maybe some Wurzels-based remixes of classic German techno. Just your normal Bill Bailey gig, then. Filmed at The O2 in Dublin in October 2010

2026-11-27.title: Ellen DeGeneres: For Your Approval
2026-11-27.overview: In the final special of her historic career, Ellen gets candid about fame, parallel parking and her life since getting "kicked out of show business".

2026-11-27.title: Tig Notaro: Boyish Girl Interrupted
2026-11-27.overview: Known for her distinctive storytelling and offbeat sense of humor, Tig Notaro often draws on her highly personal experiences with no-holds-barred honesty. Over the course of her one-hour show, Notaro tells stories about a number of subjects, including: the search for the perfect Santa Claus; her favorite laugh noises; bringing her fiancée to meet her Mississippi family; TSA screening; flying in small planes; unusual public signs; and more.

2026-11-27.title: Death to 2020
2026-11-27.overview: 2020: A year so [insert adjective of choice here], even the creators of Black Mirror couldn't make it up… but that doesn't mean they don't have a little something to add. This comedy event that tells the story of the dreadful year that was — and perhaps still is? The documentary-style special weaves together some of the world's most (fictitious) renowned voices with real-life archival footage.

2026-11-27.title: Iliza Shlesinger: Hot Forever
2026-11-27.overview: Iliza Shlesinger talks about different topics. She starts from every girl's ugly bra to how all adult men need to own a box spring.

2026-11-27.title: Hannah Einbinder: Everything Must Go
2026-11-27.overview: Hannah Einbinder takes viewers on a psychedelic thrill ride of storytelling, characters, jokes, and more.

2026-11-27.title: Zarna Garg: One in a Billion
2026-11-27.overview: Zarna Garg's taking the comedy world by storm with her first streaming stand-up special. As an unapologetic, Indian-Immigrant mom, she has plenty to joke about, and the punch lines come fast and furious.

2026-11-27.title: Kevin Hart: Zero F**ks Given
2026-11-27.overview: Kevin Hart serves up laughs and brick oven pizza from the comfort of his home, and dishes on male group chats, sex after 40 and life with COVID-19.

2026-11-27.title: Billy Connolly: High Horse Tour Live
2026-11-27.overview: Stand-up legend, Billy Connolly returns in his ‘High Horse Tour’. Even at the age of 72, the legendary Scot has a wild and manic energy—and is still as sharp as ever.

2026-11-27.title: Cocoa Brown: Famous Enough
2026-11-27.overview: Join comedian and actress Cocoa Brown on the hilarious rollercoaster ride of dating and parenting during the pandemic. She delivers the 4-1-1 on dating double standards, the fun and fails of dating younger men and surviving four walls and an eight-year-old while in quarantine as only she can in her highly anticipated comedy special.

2026-11-27.title: Brett Goldstein: The Second Best Night of Your Life
2026-11-27.overview: Emmy-winning actor, writer, and comedian Brett Goldstein brings his irresistible charm and quick wit stateside for his first HBO stand-up special. Best known for the hit shows "Ted Lasso" and "Shrinking", Goldstein sheds his testy Roy Kent façade to share his hilarious insights on love, sex, masculinity, "Sesame Street", and everything in between.

2026-11-27.title: Rhys Darby: Mystic Time Bird
2026-11-27.overview: Kiwi comic Rhys Darby brings silly wonder to the stage in his latest stand-up show. His unique brand of physical comedy combines obscure observations and sound effects as he takes you on a fantastical journey into the world of mysticism, past lives...and birds.

2026-11-27.title: My Dad Wrote a Porno
2026-11-27.overview: The hit podcast-turned-comedy special follows Jamie Morton and his co-hosts, James Cooper and Alice Levine, as they explore his father’s infamous erotic novel series, Belinda Blinked. From the Roundhouse in London, the three hosts will read from the series’ “lost chapter” in front of a live studio audience.

2026-11-27.title: Michael McIntyre: Live & Laughing
2026-11-27.overview: Acclaimed stand-up comedian Michael McIntyre delivers a hilarious performance to a receptive crowd at London's Hammersmith Apollo.

2026-11-27.title: John Mulaney: Baby J
2026-11-27.overview: A chaotic intervention. An action-packed stay in rehab. After a weird couple of years, John Mulaney comes out swinging in his return to the stage.

2026-11-27.title: T.J. Miller: Meticulously Ridiculous
2026-11-27.overview: The comic/actor T.J Miller showcases his irreverent comedy talents at the Paramount Theater in his hometown of Denver.

2026-11-28.title: Franco Escamilla: Ladies' man
2026-11-28.overview: Franco Escamilla takes the stage with tales of teenage romance gone wrong, featuring painfully long kisses and rockstar cameos with surprising outcomes.

2026-11-28.title: Torching 2024: A Roast of the Year
2026-11-28.overview: Roastmaster General Jeff Ross and a cast of comedians look back at 2024’s most memorable moments in a night of savage laughs and surprises.

2026-11-28.title: Kevin Hart: Zero F**ks Given
2026-11-28.overview: Kevin Hart serves up laughs and brick oven pizza from the comfort of his home, and dishes on male group chats, sex after 40 and life with COVID-19.

2026-11-28.title: Dane Cook: Vicious Circle
2026-11-28.overview: Vicious Circle captures the hottest comic in America in his first HBO comedy event, a unique "in the round" performance before his hometown Boston fans.

2026-11-28.title: Craig Ferguson: I'm So Happy
2026-11-28.overview: Ferguson returns to the spotlight and despite life's setbacks - his recent bout with an unknown calcified infection that plagued his eyeball, a nasty UTI, long covid, his fear of millennials, and having to tiptoe his comedy around foreign accents and his wife - Craig Ferguson is still so happy.

2026-11-28.title: Bill Maher: #Adulting
2026-11-28.overview: Filmed at Miami’s Fillmore Theater, Bill Maher’s latest stand-up special sees the acclaimed comedian, host, and satirist take the stage for a hilarious and scathing hour of his signature commentary on the latest hot-button issues.

2026-11-28.title: Dave Chappelle: Equanimity
2026-11-28.overview: Comedy legend Dave Chappelle returns to his roots with an all-new stand-up special filmed at the Warner Theatre in Washington, D.C.

2026-11-28.title: My Dad Wrote a Porno
2026-11-28.overview: The hit podcast-turned-comedy special follows Jamie Morton and his co-hosts, James Cooper and Alice Levine, as they explore his father’s infamous erotic novel series, Belinda Blinked. From the Roundhouse in London, the three hosts will read from the series’ “lost chapter” in front of a live studio audience.

2026-11-28.title: Eddie Izzard: Circle
2026-11-28.overview: Town Hall, New York City, 26 June 2000. An evening with Eddie Izzard in which she moves back and forth in time, with religion as the loose but constant theme.

2026-11-28.title: Fortune Feimster: Crushing It
2026-11-28.overview: From no longer being her mom's stand-in husband to a "romantic" honeymoon with her wife, Fortune Feimster is crushing it in this feel-good special.

2026-11-28.title: Bo Burnham: Words, Words, Words
2026-11-28.overview: Bo Burnham is back with a new one-man show full of his patented songs and wordplay, as well as haikus, dramatic readings, blasphemy, and so much more in his first hour-long special, shot live in his home town of Boston.

2026-11-28.title: I Am Chris Farley
2026-11-28.overview: I am Chris Farley tells his hilarious, touching and wildly entertaining story - from his early days in Madison, Wisconsin, to his time at Second City and Saturday Night Live, then finally his film career (which included hits like Tommy Boy and Black Sheep). The film showcases his most memorable characters and skits from film and television and also includes interviews and insights from his co-stars, family and friends - including the likes of Christina Applegate, Dan Aykroyd, Mike Myers, Bob Odenkirk, Bob Saget and Adam Sandler.

2026-11-28.title: Jack Whitehall: At Large
2026-11-28.overview: Comedian Jack Whitehall takes the stage to tell stories about drinking, drugs, a Google Maps van and his ongoing rivalry with Robert Pattinson.

2026-11-28.title: Mike Birbiglia: Thank God for Jokes
2026-11-28.overview: Mike Birbiglia declares that a joke should never end with "I’m joking." In his all-new comedy, Birbiglia tiptoes hilariously through the minefield that is modern-day joke-telling. Join Mike as he learns that the same jokes that elicit laughter have the power to produce tears, rage, and a whole lot of getting yelled at. Ultimately it's a show that asks, “How far should we go for the laugh?”

2026-11-28.title: Dave Chappelle: Sticks & Stones
2026-11-28.overview: Dave Chappelle takes on gun culture, the opioid crisis and the tidal wave of celebrity scandals in this defiant stand-up special.

2026-11-28.title: Dina Hashem: Dark Little Whispers
2026-11-28.overview: In a breakout hour of comedy, Dina Hashem discusses everything from death threats and existential dilemmas, to relationship problems, quiet people, and her upbringing as a first generation Arab-American.

2026-11-28.title: Moses Storm: Trash White
2026-11-28.overview: Comedian Moses Storm recounts memories of growing up poor, dumpster diving for food, breaking into country clubs, squaring off with carjackers while naked, and more in this hilarious and heartfelt debut standup special.

2026-11-28.title: Nick Kroll: Little Big Boy
2026-11-28.overview: Nick Kroll shares his comedian origin story, his first heartbreak, his strange hypnosis experience and the trash-talking celebrity voice in his head.

2026-11-28.title: Beth Stelling: If You Didn't Want Me Then
2026-11-28.overview: Comedian Beth Stelling is aging in dog years, camping with a fake husband and monitoring her dad's raccoon army in this slyly laid-back stand-up special.

2026-11-28.title: Iliza Shlesinger: War Paint
2026-11-28.overview: Her innocent appearance is just a cover for Last Comic Standing winner Iliza Shlesinger's acerbic, stream-of-conscious comedy that she unleashes on an unsuspecting audience in her hometown of Dallas in "War Paint," her first stand-up special.

2026-11-28.title: Alex Borstein: Corsets & Clown Suits
2026-11-28.overview: Alex Borstein performs a music-infused stand-up special from The Wolford Theatre.

2026-11-28.title: Louis C.K.: Oh My God
2026-11-28.overview: Filmed at the Celebrity Theatre in Phoenix, AZ on February 15th and 16th, 2013, Oh My God is Louis C.K.'s fifth stand-up special, his first for HBO since 2007's Shameless, and his first since winning a Emmy Award for writing on his acclaimed show on FX, Louie.  Performed in the round in front of a live audience, he discusses such topics as the food chain, animals, divorce, strange anecdotes, broken morality, murder and mortality.

2026-11-28.title: Brett Goldstein: The Second Best Night of Your Life
2026-11-28.overview: Emmy-winning actor, writer, and comedian Brett Goldstein brings his irresistible charm and quick wit stateside for his first HBO stand-up special. Best known for the hit shows "Ted Lasso" and "Shrinking", Goldstein sheds his testy Roy Kent façade to share his hilarious insights on love, sex, masculinity, "Sesame Street", and everything in between.

2026-11-28.title: Fern Brady: Autistic Bikini Queen
2026-11-28.overview: The irreverent Scottish comedian tackles big themes like death, decline and the disappointments of middle age in her stand-up special filmed in Bristol.
